title: Set up your gym
step0: Start fresh or restore a backup
failed: Could not save this step. Check the details and try again.
unreachable: The storage destination refused the request. Check the endpoint, region, bucket and access keys, which must be able to list, write, read and delete; nothing was saved.
changed: Setup changed in another window. Your progress has been refreshed.
unavailable: Setup is unavailable for this install. Sign in to manage your gym.
timezoneFallback: We couldn't use your browser's timezone, so this is set to UTC. Please check it, and enter a region such as America/Vancouver if your gym is elsewhere.
ownerRequired: Sign in as the owner to continue setup.
sent: Check your inbox for a sign-in link, then return here to continue setup.
packHint: Choose any of the shipped packs, or continue without one. Programs, ranks, and colors stay editable.
websiteHint: Link your existing website to the paths below on this gym's hostname. You can point a subdomain at this install.
smtpHint: Use an SMTP sending service such as Postmark, Brevo, or Amazon SES; check their free-tier options. Mail sent directly from the server itself lands in spam.
dnsHint: Follow your sender's SPF and DKIM instructions in your domain's DNS. Port 587 with STARTTLS is recommended. For Amazon SES, use the host for your region.
loginHint: Once email works, AUTH_PASSWORD_LOGIN=auto switches this gym to email-link sign-in. Skipping keeps any install SMTP settings; without SMTP, use your password.
smtpFailed: The test email failed. Check your SMTP settings and try again, or skip this step.
stripeHint: Payment configuration is not set up. Continue with billing paused.
restoreHint: Use the original backup private key and storage destination. A successful restore skips setup and keeps billing paused.
restoring: Restoring your verified backup. Keep this page open; billing will stay paused.
restoreFailed: Restore failed. Check the source and key. If a verified restore was interrupted, resume it with the maintenance command.
pollFailed: Could not read restore progress. Reload this page to retry.
restored: Backup restored. Sign in to your restored gym. Billing remains paused until reconciliation.
setupLink: Open the private setup link printed by the installer. You can reprint it with gym-app setup-link on the server.
backupHint: Snapshots are encrypted before uploading. Only your backup private key can open them.
retention: Backups use an 8 GB budget, keeping 24 hourly, 7 nightly, 4 weekly, and up to 2 pre-upgrade snapshots when capacity permits.
savedKey: I saved my private key somewhere safe
finished: Your gym is ready. Billing and member emails remain paused.
testBody: Your gym can send email through its configured sending service.
seeError: See the message at the top of this step.
googleRejected: Google didn't accept this client ID and secret, so nothing was saved. Copy both again from your OAuth client in Google Cloud, then save.
portHint: Many hosting providers block outgoing email on ports 25, 465 and 587. If the test email times out, use your sending service's alternative port, such as 2525.
emailSent: Test email sent to {address}. Check your inbox (and spam folder), then continue.
backupsOn: Backups are on: the destination passed its check. The first snapshot runs at the start of the next hour, then every hour.
endpointHint: The service's address, such as https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, without the bucket name.
check.email: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
check.timezone: Enter an IANA timezone, such as America/Vancouver or Europe/London.
check.currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as USD or EUR.
check.url: Enter a full address starting with https://.
check.port: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.
check.bucketPath: Use the address without the bucket name.
check.bucketInEndpoint: The endpoint above ends with this bucket: use the endpoint address without the bucket name.
check.googleValue: Paste the value without spaces (at most 512 characters).
